solo.name: drain succeeds when every shard keeps a replica
solo.trace:
solo check: drain succeeds when every shard keeps a replica
call: drain_node(db, node_id='A')
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  SELECT s.id FROM shards s JOIN replicas r ON s.id = r.shard_id WHERE r.node_id = 'A' AND r.active = true ORDER BY s.id FOR UPDATE -> [(1,), (2,)]
step 3   R1  SELECT s.shard_id FROM unnest('{1,2}'::int2[]) AS s(shard_id) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM replicas r WHERE r.shard_id = s.shard_id AND r.active = true AND r.node_id != 'A' ) -> []
step 4   R1  UPDATE replicas SET active = false WHERE node_id = 'A' AND active = true -> UPDATE 2
step 5   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: every shard has at least one active replica
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT array_agg(active ORDER BY shard_id, node_id) = '{f,t,f,t}' FROM replicas
